recap.paragraph: Virginia Tech led by 14, but No. 7 Miami came roaring back in Florida! Jake Weinberg kicked a school-record 59-yard field goal before halftime. Mark Fletcher Jr. scored to give Miami its first lead in the fourth quarter. He scored again and finished with 3 rushing touchdowns. Virginia Tech's last fourth-down pass fell incomplete. Miami won 28-20 and earned a spot in the ACC title game.
